# Steve's Handyman LLC

> Precision Residential Handyman & Remodeling Contractor in Denison, Texas.

Steve's Handyman LLC is a licensed and $1M insured multi-trade home repair contractor founded by master craftsman Steve Miller. Serving Denison, Sherman, Pottsboro, Lake Texoma, and Grayson County, Texas with transparent upfront pricing, clean job-site practices, and an unconditional 1-year craftsmanship guarantee.

## Core Capabilities
- Custom Finish Carpentry: Crown molding, baseboards, door casing, wainscoting, cabinet refacing, built-ins.
- Drywall & Texture Matching: Water damage repairs, stress crack repair, orange peel and knockdown texture matching.
- Plumbing & Electrical Fixtures: Kitchen faucets, sink replacements, garbage disposals, toilets, LED recessed pot lights, ceiling fans, GFCI outlets.
- Decks, Fences & Rot Remediation: Exterior fascia, soffits, deck joist repairs, pressure washing, and staining.
- General Punch-List & Home Inspection Repairs: Multi-item single visit repair service.
